messages:
Evan (AE): Heads-up — Ohio Health is asking for our SOC 2 report + temporary evidence access for a POC next week. They want a signed NDA, a short bridge-letter, and presigned links to a handful of artifacts. Can we turn this around fast?
Kim (SE): We can do presigned S3 links. Need exact list of artifacts (control narratives, test evidence, syslogs?). Default presign expiry is 72h. Do they want the full report PDF or extracts?
Rita (InfoSec): Prefer to avoid handing full raw evidence. Provide SOC2 PDF + curated extracts. Legal needs NDA + bridge-letter acknowledging temporary, limited access. Also we must assign a custodian for audit logs retention. @Marta can you confirm minimal language?
Marta (Legal): Yes — we require a signed NDA and a short bridge letter. I have a template: https://redwood.internal/legal/templates/bridge-letter-v1.docx. For expedited cases we'll approve interim access IF: 1) file set is limited and documented, 2) presigned links expire <= 7 days, 3) recipient list provided.
Evan (AE): Customer will sign NDA today. Requestor: j.smith@ohiohealth.org + sec-ops@ohiohealth.org. They asked whether we can extend presign to 14 days.
Rita (InfoSec): 14 days is too long for raw evidence. For the SOC2 PDF we can allow 14 days. For any evidence extracts, max 7 days. Also require SSE and server access logging on the S3 objects. (Note: 7 days = 604800s, 14 days = 1209600s)
Kim (SE): Quick how-to for presign: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-prod/soc2/extracts/<file> --expires-in 604800` — I can generate the links once Legal approves the file list. I can also redact obvious PII (simple scrub) but anything deeper needs InfoSec sign-off.
Marta (Legal): Add this clause to the bridge letter: "Access limited to procurement/security review; no copying or onward distribution; all access will be logged; questions to legal@redwood.com." I'll include the standard 2-hour included handoff clause for sales.
Evan (AE): I'll need the NDA sent via DocuSign. @Jules can you send that and attach the bridge-letter template? Also confirm custodian should be `security-ops@redwood.com`.
Jules (Customer Success): On it — sending DocuSign now to j.smith@ohiohealth.org and sec-ops alias. I'll attach the bridge-letter draft. ETA ~30m. Will set recipients and notify once signed.
Rita (InfoSec): After NDA is signed I will approve the final artifact list. For anything marked "evidence" we redact PII fields. If Ohio Health needs a deeper review we can schedule a controlled session (screen-share + recorded attendees) instead of full downloads.
Evan (AE): Two quick policy/pricing items they asked about: 1) Does SOC2 access count as billable PS time? 2) If they request custom extracts + redaction will that be chargeable?
Marta (Legal): Confirmed — up to 2 hours of sales/hand-off support included. Anything beyond (custom extracts, redaction, extended custodian work) will be billed at PS rates. I'll add a line to the bridge letter to make that explicit.
presign-bot: deploy: presign-worker scheduled at 23:15 UTC — FYI for operations.
Evan (AE): Great, thanks everyone. I'll update Ohio Health after NDA is signed and send the final artifact list. Keeping this thread for audit trail. :thumbsup:
